Name: Wildflour's Cuter Artisan Goods
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
If you enjoy Cuter Crops and Foraging, then you will LOVE it's new companion mod: Cuter Artisan Goods!

Retextures eggs, mayo, milk, cheeses, wool, cloth, jams, pickles, honey, alcoholic and caffeinated beverages, as well as tree fruits and saps and probably something else I forgot to list.

You may notice a few fun changes for things like rabbit's foot and aged roe ;)

I used cometkins “Better Artisan Goods” as a base for this mod (see their page for permissions) and then a lot of the artwork is modified from [url=https://pixerelia.itch.io/]Pixerelia[/url], [url=https://dantepixels.itch.io/]DantePixels[/url] and some are my own as I get slowly get more experienced at pixel art. I try to add my own little cute flair to things so I hope you like it! 

After installing it should generate a config file so you can turn on/off whatever items you want to.

[size=5][b][u]2.0 UPDATE![/u][/b][/size]

Hey friends it's been awhile since I've taken a look at this mod and  with the newer mods I'm releasing, I felt it needed a bit of a visual update. I want to keep the vibe cohesive across my mods so we have several sprite changes!

No need to worry if you'd prefer to keep the older sprites; don't download the update and just change the "version number" in the manifest.json file to say 2.0 and you're all set. I'll also leave the file in the optional files/archive. 

You'll see milks are now milk cartons, juices are juice boxes, wine is now a mason jar cocktail and more. [b]I'll be updating the BAGI files as well[/b], not only with the new versions of sprites but also to include icons for fruit tree honeys and meads now that we can do that (thanks to amazing modders like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11911]VonLoewe[/url] ). I'll also be creating a BAGI file for the forage items added in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14653]Wild Food Mod[/url], just as soon as I[s] sleep [/s]get some free time.
